title: 第123章 为大家的热情再写一篇（顾赵现代番外）
slug: 给你尊荣你不要来世我去娶郡主
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

上京城的雨，淅淅沥沥，缠缠绵绵。

顾尘的眼睛缓缓睁开。

入眼的，是爱妻赵虹琳那张明艳不可方物的脸。

她正撑着手肘，眼波流转地打量他。

“琳琳。”

“醒啦？”

带着初醒的慵懒，赵虹琳指尖撩拨着他的耳朵：“昨晚，我又梦到了一世。你呢？是不是也梦见了呀？”

顾尘撑起身子，望着妻子那双盛着千山万水的眼睛。

昨夜梦里的光景犹在脑中，那是一座悬在云雾里的青瓦医馆，药香每日漫过石阶。

那一世，他和她，守着师傅传给二人的一家小医馆。

听说他们妙手回春盛名的人，会不远万里来求医。

他诊脉，她开方，他捣药，她煎汤，伴着满架子的药经医书，日子过得富足又安康。

有时候遇到疑难杂症，两个人便对坐在灯下，翻着泛黄的医书研论到深夜。

就这样，白头偕老，岁月静好，就又是安顺平和的一辈子。

顾尘回答：“梦到了，咱们在大胤朝太安年间……竟开了间医馆，救了四方百姓，连宫里的都来求过咱们的方子。”

赵虹琳“噗嗤”一声，嘴里带着爽利：

“你就尽说好的，我可是记得，你刚到师傅手底下，笨手笨脚的，什么药材都分不清，还把药柜都打翻了两回呢，师傅气得吹胡子瞪眼。”

她说着，俯下身，在他耳边呵气如兰：“不过……笨得挺可爱哦。顾，师，弟。”

她叫“顾师弟”的时候，顺手来回撩拨他的鼻子，嘴里带着戏谑，又带着蜜糖似的甜。

顾尘耳根发热，顺势将她搂进怀里。

顾尘和赵虹琳。

他们，相识于清京大学。

那一年，他们大一，是同院系不同专业的。

就有那么一天。

她抱着一摞书从教学楼出来，他骑着自行车从坡上冲下来，差点撞上。

书散了一地，她忙着蹲下身去捡，他也慌忙刹车去帮忙，两个人的手同时触到同一本《北境英雄传》，指尖碰在一起，都缩了回去。

他们同时抬起头，齐齐对视。

只是觉得，这人怎么看着就这般顺眼？

难不成是前世欠下的债，今生得拿一辈子来还？

就这样，两人互加联系方式，公共课上出双入对，一起看电影，一起吃冰淇淋，一起读书自习，一起考研读博。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The rain in the capital was pattering and lingering.

Gu Chen's eyes slowly opened.

What catches the eye is the bright and beautiful face of his beloved wife Zhao Honglin.

She was resting on her elbows, looking at him with wandering eyes.

"Linlin."

"Are you awake?"

With the laziness of waking up, Zhao Honglin teased his ears with her fingertips: "Last night, I dreamed about my whole life again. What about you? Did you dream about it too?"

Gu Chen propped himself up and looked into his wife's eyes filled with mountains and rivers.

The scene from last night's dream is still in my mind. It was a blue-tiled medical clinic suspended in the clouds and mist, and the fragrance of medicine filled the stone steps every day.

In that life, he and she guarded a small medical clinic passed down to them by their master.

People who heard about their reputation for magical rejuvenation would travel thousands of miles to seek medical treatment.

He diagnoses the pulse, she prescribes prescriptions, he mixes medicine, and she decoctions soup. Accompanied by shelves full of medicinal classics and medical books, they live a prosperous and healthy life.

Sometimes when encountering difficult and complicated diseases, the two of them would sit opposite each other under the lamp, flipping through yellowed medical books and studying until late at night.

In this way, we grow old together, the years are peaceful, and we live an peaceful and peaceful life again.

Gu Chen replied: "I dreamed that during the Tai'an period of the Dayin Dynasty... we actually opened a medical clinic and saved people from all over the world. Even people in the palace came to ask for our prescriptions."

Zhao Honglin made a "puff" sound with a refreshing tone in her mouth:

"Just do what you say, but I remember that when you first came under the master's hands, you were so clumsy that you couldn't distinguish any medicinal materials. You even knocked over the medicine cabinet twice. The master was so angry that he blew his beard and stared."

As she spoke, she leaned down and breathed Rulan into his ear: "But...it's cute to be stupid. Gu, master, brother."

When she called "Junior Brother Gu", she flicked his nose back and forth, her mouth was playful and sweet as honey.

Gu Chen's ears felt hot and he hugged her into his arms.

Gu Chen and Zhao Honglin.

They met at Qingjing University.

That year, they were freshmen in the same department and in different majors.

Just one day.

She came out of the teaching building with a stack of books in her arms. He rushed down the slope on his bicycle and almost ran into her.

The books were scattered on the floor, and she hurriedly knelt down to pick them up. He also hurriedly braked to help. Their hands touched the same "Heroes of the North" at the same time, and their fingertips touched together and they both retracted.

They raised their heads at the same time and looked at each other.

I just feel like, why does this person look so pleasing to the eye?

Could it be that it is a debt owed in a previous life that will take a lifetime to repay in this life?

In this way, the two of them added contact information to each other, went out together in public classes, watched movies together, ate ice cream together, read and studied together, and took postgraduate entrance examinations together.
